dialog.english:
Tai! Get yourself together!
Hey, Tai...
dialog.translation:
Tai! Espabila!
Oye, Tai...

dialog.english: A-Agumon... Where are we?
dialog.translation: Agumon... dónde estamos?

dialog.english:
I feel like we've been here
before. I definitely feel like
we've been here before...
dialog.translation:
Tengo la sensación de que ya
hemos estado aquí. En serio,
ya hemos estado aquí...

dialog.english: Where are the others?
dialog.translation: Dónde están todos?

dialog.english:
They're not here. Looks like it's
just us.
dialog.translation:
No están. Parece que solo
estamos nosotros.

dialog.english:
No way... We just got back to the
Digital World from Tokyo...
dialog.translation:
No puede ser... si volvimos
de Tokio al Digimundo ahora...

dialog.english:
We'd set up camp and were sleeping
by the bonfire like we always
do...
dialog.translation:
Acampamos y dormíamos junto
a la hoguera, como siempre...

dialog.english:
Do you think maybe we're in a
dream?
dialog.translation: Crees que esto es un sueño?

dialog.english:
A dream? Then why are both of us
in the same dream?
dialog.translation:
Un sueño? Y por qué
estamos los dos en el mismo?

dialog.english: I guess it's not a dream, then.
dialog.translation: Pues entonces no es un sueño.

dialog.english: What's that?
dialog.translation: Qué es eso?

dialog.english: Someone's coming.
dialog.translation: Viene alguien.

dialog.english: Don't move!
dialog.translation: Quieto!

dialog.english: It's a Digimon! Who are you?
dialog.translation: Es un Digimon! Quién eres?

dialog.english:
I should be asking *you* that!
What are you doing here?
dialog.translation:
Esa pregunta te la hago yo!
Qué haces tú aquí?

dialog.english:
There's no reason for you to
suspect us! We were here before we
knew it!
dialog.translation:
No tienes motivos para
sospecharnos! Aparecimos aquí
sin darnos cuenta!

dialog.english: Really now...?
dialog.translation: En serio...?

dialog.english:
Hey, but you guys look pretty
strong!
dialog.translation: Oye, pero parecéis fuertes!

dialog.english: Huh?
dialog.translation: Eh?

dialog.english:
Wanna fight and see who's
stronger?
dialog.translation:
Peleamos a ver quién es
más fuerte?

dialog.english: Wait, are you talking to me?
dialog.translation: A mí me hablas?

dialog.english: Yeah!
dialog.translation: Sí!

dialog.english: What?!
dialog.translation: Qué?!

dialog.english: T-Tai...
dialog.translation: T-Tai...

dialog.english:
Hey, hey, wait a second! You're
saying some weird stuff, you
know...
dialog.translation:
Espera, espera! Estás
diciendo cosas muy raras...

dialog.english: I'm not a "you"! I'm Hackmon!
dialog.translation: No soy un tú! Soy Hackmon!

dialog.english:
Uh, Hackmon... why do you want to
fight Agumon?
dialog.translation:
Hackmon... por qué
quieres pelear con Agumon?

dialog.english:
Why? Because I'm itchin' to fight
someone strong!
dialog.translation:
Porque tengo ganas de pelear
con alguien fuerte!

dialog.english:
I don't know why I'm here or what
for, but...
dialog.translation:
No sé por qué estoy aquí
ni para qué, pero...

dialog.english:
I just feel like getting in a
nice, long brawl!
dialog.translation:
Solo tengo ganas de una buena
pelea larga!

dialog.english: Wait, you were brought here, too?
dialog.translation: Espera, a ti también te trajeron?

dialog.english:
Yeah! While I was doing my
training off in the mountains...
dialog.translation:
Sí! Mientras entrenaba
en las montañas...

dialog.english:
Someone approached me while I was
taking a nap, and before I knew it
I was here!
dialog.translation:
Alguien se me acercó mientras
dormía la siesta, y de repente
ya estaba aquí!

dialog.english:
I was sleeping, so I didn't get to
see them, but I certainly felt
someone's presence!
dialog.translation:
Estaba dormido, así que no lo vi,
pero sentí la presencia
de alguien, seguro!

dialog.english: Someone's presence?
dialog.translation: Sentiste a alguien?

dialog.english: What's wrong, Agumon?
dialog.translation: Qué pasa, Agumon?

dialog.english:
I forgot to say this earlier,
but...
dialog.translation:
Se me olvidó decir esto antes
pero...

dialog.english:
I also felt like there was someone
standing behind us while we were
sleeping.
dialog.translation:
También sentí que había alguien
detrás de nosotros mientras
dormíamos.

dialog.english:
What?! Why didn't you tell me that
earlier?
dialog.translation:
Qué?! Por qué no me lo dijiste
antes?

dialog.english:
I thought maybe I was just
dreaming...
dialog.translation:
Pensé que a lo mejor
estaba soñando...

dialog.english: Well, that's fair...
dialog.translation: Tiene lógica...

dialog.english:
So it seems like you're in my
boat, then.
dialog.translation:
Parece que estás en mi
misma situación.

dialog.english: Nice to meet you!
dialog.translation: Encantado!

dialog.english:
I don't wanna hear that! Come on,
fight me!
dialog.translation:
No quiero oír eso! Vamos,
pelea conmigo!

dialog.english: Hey... Hey, Tai...
dialog.translation: Oye... oye, Tai...

dialog.english:
Hey, why don't we start looking
for the exit instead?
dialog.translation:
Oye, por qué no buscamos
la salida mejor?

dialog.english:
Yeah, yeah, we've been here
before, so we should be able to
find an exit!
dialog.translation:
Sí, sí, ya hemos estado aquí,
así que deberíamos encontrar
una salida!

dialog.english: Hm...
dialog.translation: Hm...

dialog.english:
Aren't there people out there who
are gonna be worried about you?
dialog.translation:
No hay gente ahí fuera
preocupada por ti?

dialog.english:
Well, I'm sure "they" would be
concerned about my absence, but...
dialog.translation:
Seguro que "ellos" estarían
preocupados por mi ausencia,
pero...

dialog.english: Are "they" your friends?
dialog.translation: "Ellos" son tus amigos?

dialog.english:
They're not my friends! More like
my caretakers.
dialog.translation:
No son mis amigos! Más bien
mis cuidadores.

dialog.english: Huh... so you have caretakers?
dialog.translation: Vaya... tienes cuidadores?

dialog.english: You're weird.
dialog.translation: Eres raro.

dialog.english:
Whatever! Let's find a way out of
here first.
dialog.translation:
Da igual! Busquemos primero
cómo salir de aquí

dialog.english: ...Are we gonna be okay?
dialog.translation: ...Vamos a estar bien?

dialog.english: I'm worried, too...
dialog.translation: Yo también...

dialog.english:
Hey, Tai! You're not a Digimon,
are you?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Tai! No eres un Digimon,
verdad?

dialog.english:
Nope! I came to the Digimon world
from another one.
dialog.translation:
No! Vine al mundo Digimon
desde otro mundo.

dialog.english:
How'd you get there from another
world?
dialog.translation:
Cómo llegaste aquí desde
otro mundo?

dialog.english:
Well, at first we couldn't get
back to our world at all, and then
a lot of stuff happened...
dialog.translation:
Al principio no podíamos volver
a nuestro mundo, y luego
pasaron muchas cosas...

dialog.english:
So, Hackmon, what kind of stuff do
you usually do?
dialog.translation:
Y tú, Hackmon, qué sueles
hacer normalmente?

dialog.english: I'm training to become stronger!
dialog.translation: Entreno para hacerme más fuerte!

dialog.english: Is that it?
dialog.translation: Solo eso?

dialog.english: Yup! I have a dream, you see.
dialog.translation: Sí! Tengo un sueño, ya ves.

dialog.english: What's your dream?
dialog.translation: Cuál es tu sueño?

dialog.english: Heh heh heh, that's a secret!
dialog.translation: Je je je, eso es secreto!

dialog.english: Aw, man.
dialog.translation: Vaya.

dialog.english: Ah! There's the exit!
dialog.translation: Ahí está la salida!

dialog.english: You're right!
dialog.translation: Tienes razón!

dialog.english:
So I guess we're parting ways,
huh?
dialog.translation:
Entonces nos separamos,
no?

dialog.english:
Hey, Agumon! Can you do me a
favor?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Agumon! Me haces
un favor?

dialog.english: What?
dialog.translation: Qué?

dialog.english: Next time we meet, fight me!
dialog.translation: La próxima vez, pelea!

dialog.english: Huh?! Are you serious?
dialog.translation: Eh?! En serio?

dialog.english:
Of course! I'm gonna be really
strong by then!
dialog.translation:
Claro! Para entonces seré
muy fuerte!

dialog.english: Hahaha! I knew you'd say that.
dialog.translation: Jajaja! Sabía que dirías eso.

dialog.english:
Hey, Tai, at least say
something about this...
dialog.translation:
Oye, Tai, di algo al menos
sobre esto...

dialog.english: See you, Hackmon!
dialog.translation: Adiós, Hackmon!

dialog.english: Yeah! Take care, you two!
dialog.translation: Sí! Cuidaos los dos!

dialog.english: 【Area 1】
dialog.translation: Zona 1

dialog.english: 【Area 2】
dialog.translation: Zona 2

dialog.english: 【Area 3】
dialog.translation: Zona 3
